audits.observations: Root ordered second reading: whole and both actual supplied halves personally viewed before image-first receipt and text opening, then39 fresh crops viewed, including the slanted manuscript number rotated upright. Every agreed and differing word, accent, arrow, index, underline, cancellation and addition was compared with the ink. Four physical word divisions restored. The underlying g below condition v is resolved from its two bowls/descender. The final letter of cancelled ra de remains uncertain e|a after closer inspection. The retouched q in lequel is tagged handwritten without a lexical collation row, since the word is unchanged. A t-like underlying glyph in quasi-compact is retained with doubt beneath the c correction. Circled superset and plus petit enclosure gaps/tails are represented. All three implications show paired shafts; morphism arrows and the leftward limit arrow remain single. Aut arguments retain their differing levels of legibility. The live H over an uncertain earlier G, lemma comma-like mark, plain underlined O, Soient and the large cancellation scope are retained. Manuscript18 and archive49 remain distinct. Eight doubts remain. No context or mathematical proof check was used.
